title: Highpass Filter
text: Design FIR or IIR highpass filter, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding method; {Filter type} sets the fIR, {Design minimum order filter} sets the design filter with minimum order, {Filter order} sets the order of highpass filter, {Stopband edge frequency (Hz)} sets the stopband edge frequency 8e3, {Passband edge frequency (Hz)} sets the passband edge frequency 12e3, {Minimum stopband attenuation (dB)}, {Maximum passband ripple (dB)}, {Sample rate mode} sets the mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized, {Input sample rate (Hz)}, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {View Filter Response} sets the open Filter Visualization and {Coefficients} sets the coefficient data type fixdt. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal to filter column vector | matrix

params.name: Filter type
params.values: FIR or IIR filter FIR (default) | IIR

params.name: Design minimum order filter
params.values: Design filter with minimum order on (default) | off

params.name: Filter order
params.values: Order of highpass filter 50 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Stopband edge frequency (Hz)
params.values: Stopband edge frequency 8e3 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Passband edge frequency (Hz)
params.values: Passband edge frequency 12e3 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Minimum stopband attenuation (dB)
params.values: Minimum stopband attenuation 80 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Maximum passband ripple (dB)
params.values: Maximum passband ripple 0.1 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Sample rate mode
params.values: Mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized frequency (0 to 1) (default) | Specify on dialog | Inherit from input port

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding method Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero
